title: Tokenized Stocks Shrug Off the Crypto Selloff
summary: Tokenized Stocks Shrug Off the Crypto Selloff Bitcoin fell as low as $62k late Saturday, its sixth straight weekly decline. Meanwhile, tokenized stocks crossed $4 billion in onchain value for the first time on Nov 11. Tokenized stocks are now roughly five times their value on January 1.
